description: Demolition of existing single storey rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension with roof lantern. Erection of a detached outbuilding at rear of house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (20195/01 Rev A, received on 10/12/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the single storey rear extension hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the single storey rear extension and outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.
